blackholeCommandDescription.zh-CN: 手动压缩并生成结构化摘要。子命令：[settings] 配置面板，[changelog] 显示更新日志，[cleanup] 清理孤立文件，[om-off]/[om-on] 关闭/开启观察记忆。
blackholeCommandDescription.en-US: Manual compact with structural summary. Subcommands: [settings] config overlay, [changelog] display changelog, [cleanup] remove orphaned files, [om-off]/[om-on] disable/enable observational memory.

blackholeSubCleanup.zh-CN: 清理孤立的待处理文件 [cleanup]

memoryCommandDescription.zh-CN: 显示记忆流水线状态和 token 计数。/blackhole-memory [view] 可见的观察与反思，[full] 完整记录的记忆（复制到剪贴板）。
memoryCommandDescription.en-US: Show memory pipeline status & token counters. /blackhole-memory [view] visible observations & reflections, [full] complete recorded memory (copies to clipboard).

exportCommandDescription.zh-CN: 把提炼后的项目记忆（来自过往会话的观察与反思）导出为 markdown。用法：/blackhole-export [out:<路径>]。不指定 out: 时写入项目当前工作目录。
exportCommandDescription.en-US: Export distilled project memory (observations/reflections from past sessions) to markdown. Usage: /blackhole-export [out:<path>]. If no out: is provided, writes to the project local cwd.

recallCommandDescription.zh-CN: 搜索会话历史。默认搜索当前分支。用法：/blackhole-recall <查询> [page:N] [scope:all] [mode:file|touched]
recallCommandDescription.en-US: Search session history. Defaults to active lineage. Usage: /blackhole-recall <query> [page:N] [scope:all] [mode:file|touched]

omDisabled.zh-CN: 观察记忆已关闭。使用 /blackhole om-on 重新开启。
omDisabled.en-US: Observational memory disabled. Use /blackhole om-on to re-enable.

configSaveFailed.zh-CN: 保存配置失败，配置文件可能是只读的（例如由 Nix 管理）。本次会话的运行状态已更新。
configSaveFailed.en-US: Failed to save config — the config file may be read-only (e.g., managed by Nix). Runtime state updated for this session only.

subcommandNoArgs.zh-CN: /blackhole {name} 不接受参数。你是想输入 "/blackhole {name}" 吗？
subcommandNoArgs.en-US: /blackhole {name} accepts no arguments. Did you mean "/blackhole {name}"?

pendingFlushed.zh-CN: 观察记忆：待处理条目已写入

exportStarting.zh-CN: 正在导出项目记忆…根据项目的会话文件数量，可能需要几分钟。
exportStarting.en-US: Exporting project memory… this may take a few minutes depending on the number of session files for the project.

exportPathNotMarkdown.zh-CN: 导出路径必须是 markdown 文件：{path}。请使用 out:<文件路径>.md
exportPathNotMarkdown.en-US: Export path must be a markdown file: {path}. Use out:<path-to-file>.md

exportPathEscapes.zh-CN: 导出路径超出当前目录：{path}

exportScanningMarkers.zh-CN: 正在扫描 {total} 个会话文件中的观察记忆标记…
exportScanningMarkers.en-US: Scanning {total} session files for observational memory markers…

exportScanningProgress.zh-CN: 正在扫描 {scanned}/{total} 个会话文件…

exportNoneFound.zh-CN: 没有为 {project} 找到观察记忆（已扫描 {sessions} 个会话）。
exportNoneFound.en-US: No observational memory found for {project} ({sessions} sessions scanned).

exportRanking.zh-CN: 正在排序 {observations} 条观察和 {reflections} 条反思…

exportSessionsLine.zh-CN: - 已扫描会话：{considered}（{withMarkers} 个含记忆条目）

exportObservationsLine.zh-CN: - 观察：{total} → 渲染 {rendered}（合并重复 {duplicates}，低于阈值 {filtered}{covered}）
exportObservationsLine.en-US: - observations: {total} → {rendered} rendered ({duplicates} duplicates collapsed, {filtered} below viability gate{covered})

exportTopicGroups.zh-CN: - 识别出 {count} 个主题组；每条观察显示其主题标记
exportTopicGroups.en-US: - {count} topic groups identified; each observation shows its **topic badge**

exportUnattributed.zh-CN: - 未归属的待处理记忆：{observations} 条观察 / {reflections} 条反思，来自 {sessions} 个丢失的会话
exportUnattributed.en-US: - unattributed pending memory: {observations} obs / {reflections} reflections from {sessions} lost session(s)

exportDroppedExcluded.zh-CN: - 已排除被丢弃器修剪的 id：{count}

exportFooter.zh-CN: 该文件是纯 markdown，可以整理后导入任何记忆系统。
exportFooter.en-US: The file is plain markdown — curate it, then import into any memory system.

cleanupNone.zh-CN: pi-blackhole：没有找到孤立的待处理文件。
cleanupNone.en-US: pi-blackhole: No orphaned pending files found.

cleanupListHeader.zh-CN: 孤立的待处理文件：{count} 个（{size} KB）

cleanupListFooter.zh-CN: 在 TUI 模式下使用 /blackhole cleanup 删除这些文件。
cleanupListFooter.en-US: Use /blackhole cleanup in TUI mode to delete these files.

cleanupDeleted.zh-CN: pi-blackhole：已删除 {count} 个孤立的待处理文件。

cleanupDeletedPartial.zh-CN: pi-blackhole：已删除 {deleted}/{intended} 个孤立的待处理文件（{failed} 个失败）。
cleanupDeletedPartial.en-US: pi-blackhole: Deleted {deleted}/{intended} orphaned pending file{plural} ({failed} failed).

cleanupPartial.zh-CN: pi-blackhole：已删除 {deleted} 个，剩余 {remaining} 个（{size} KB）。

cleanupAllRemoved.en-US: pi-blackhole: All {count} orphaned pending file{plural} removed.

omModelNotFound.zh-CN: 观察记忆：找不到 {stage} 模型 {model}

omNoAuth.zh-CN: 观察记忆：{stage} 没有 {provider} 的鉴权

omStageKeptFailed.zh-CN: 观察记忆：{stage} 保留了{kept}，但后续轮次失败（{detail}）
omStageKeptFailed.en-US: Observational memory: {stage} kept its {kept}, but a later turn failed ({detail})

omFailDeterministicCooled.zh-CN: 确定性错误，模型已冷却；详情见冷却日志
omFailDeterministicCooled.en-US: deterministic error, model cooled down; details in cooldown log

omFailDeterministicNoCooldown.zh-CN: 确定性错误；未记录冷却

omFailTransientDebug.zh-CN: 临时错误；详情见调试日志
omFailTransientDebug.en-US: transient error; details in debug log

omFailTransientNoDebug.zh-CN: 临时错误；启用 debugLog 可查看详情
omFailTransientNoDebug.en-US: transient error; enable debugLog for details

projectConfigFileInvalid.zh-CN: 项目配置文件 ".pi/{filename}" {error}。使用默认值。
projectConfigFileInvalid.en-US: Project config file ".pi/{filename}" is {error}. Using defaults.

manualAlreadyCompacted.zh-CN: blackhole：已经压缩过；自上次摘要后没有新内容可压缩。
manualAlreadyCompacted.en-US: blackhole: already compacted — nothing new to compact since the last summary

manualNothingToCompact.zh-CN: blackhole：暂时没有内容可压缩；Pi 的最近内容预算仍覆盖当前分支。
manualNothingToCompact.en-US: blackhole: nothing to compact yet — Pi's keep-recent budget still covers this branch

migrationReminder.zh-CN: blackhole：使用 `/blackhole configure` 保存更新后的配置。
migrationReminder.en-US: blackhole: Use `/blackhole configure` to save your updated configuration.

compactionStats.zh-CN: blackhole：已处理 {summarized} 个源条目；尾部保留 {kept}/{total} 个用户轮次{smart}{all}（约 {tokens} token）。
compactionStats.en-US: blackhole: {summarized} source entries processed; tail kept {kept}/{total} user turns{smart}{all} (~{tokens} tok).

ownCutNoLiveMessages.zh-CN: blackhole：没有内容可压缩（没有活动消息）。
ownCutNoLiveMessages.en-US: blackhole: Nothing to compact (no live messages)

ownCutTooFewLiveMessages.zh-CN: blackhole：活动消息过少；Pi 的默认逻辑会保留可见上下文。把配置中的 tailBehavior 设为 "minimal" 可在消息较少时强制压缩。
ownCutTooFewLiveMessages.en-US: blackhole: Too few live messages — Pi's default logic preserves visible context. Set tailBehavior to "minimal" in config to force compaction with fewer messages.

appendSummaryFallback.zh-CN: pi-blackhole：追加摘要模式已回退到完整替换摘要（{reason}）；运行 /blackhole 可重新基于追加片段生成摘要。
appendSummaryFallback.en-US: pi-blackhole: append summary mode fell back to a complete replacement summary ({reason}); run /blackhole to rebase back into append segments

contextStillTooLarge.zh-CN: blackhole：压缩后估算上下文仍超过可用容量；Pi 会继续处理溢出重试或错误。
contextStillTooLarge.en-US: blackhole: estimated context still exceeds available capacity after compaction; Pi overflow retry/error handling remains in control

staleCompactionSkipped.zh-CN: 观察记忆：自动压缩已跳过；延迟任务运行前扩展上下文已失效（内存会话会在 agent_end 后立即释放）；请查看 /blackhole-memory status。
staleCompactionSkipped.en-US: Observational memory: auto-compaction skipped — the extension ctx went stale before the deferred compaction ran (in-memory sessions disposed right after agent_end lose this race); see /blackhole-memory status

adapterFallbackNonPersisted.en-US: ; non-persisted sessions will not be compacted

adapterFallbackSettled.zh-CN: ；将使用 settled compaction 回退方案

midRunInlineUnavailable.zh-CN: 观察记忆：中途内联压缩不可用：{reason}{fallback}
midRunInlineUnavailable.en-US: Observational memory: mid-run inline compaction unavailable: {reason}{fallback}

midRunThresholdReached.zh-CN: 观察记忆：中途压缩阈值已达到（约 {tokens} token）；正在{mode}
midRunThresholdReached.en-US: Observational memory: compaction threshold reached mid-run (~{tokens} tokens); compacting{mode}

midRunInlineComplete.zh-CN: 观察记忆：透明的中途内联压缩已完成
midRunInlineComplete.en-US: Observational memory: transparent mid-run compaction complete

midRunInlineFailed.zh-CN: 观察记忆：透明的中途内联压缩失败：{message}{retry}
midRunInlineFailed.en-US: Observational memory: transparent mid-run compaction failed: {message}{retry}

midRunPausedComplete.zh-CN: 观察记忆：中途压缩已完成；Agent 已暂停
midRunPausedComplete.en-US: Observational memory: mid-run compaction complete; agent paused

midRunFailed.zh-CN: 观察记忆：中途压缩失败：{message}{retry}

autoCompactionThresholdReached.zh-CN: 观察记忆：压缩阈值已达到（约 {tokens} token）；正在触发压缩
autoCompactionThresholdReached.en-US: Observational memory: compaction threshold reached (~{tokens} tokens); triggering compaction

compactionSessionChanged.zh-CN: 观察记忆：压缩已取消；压缩前会话已切换
compactionSessionChanged.en-US: Observational memory: compaction cancelled — session changed before compaction

compactionAlreadyRan.zh-CN: 观察记忆：压缩已跳过；延迟压缩前已有其他压缩完成
compactionAlreadyRan.en-US: Observational memory: compaction skipped — another compaction already ran before deferred compaction

omSkippingFailedCycle.zh-CN: 观察记忆：{stage} 正在跳过 {model}（本轮已失败，已关闭冷却）。
omSkippingFailedCycle.en-US: Observational memory: {stage} skipping {model} (failed this cycle, cooldown disabled)

omSkippingCooldown.zh-CN: 观察记忆：{stage} 正在跳过 {model}（冷却中；详情见冷却日志）。
omSkippingCooldown.en-US: Observational memory: {stage} skipping {model} (cooldown — details in cooldown log)

omAllCandidatesFailed.zh-CN: 观察记忆：{stage} 已跳过；所有候选模型均失败（已关闭 sessionFallback，不会使用主模型）。
omAllCandidatesFailed.en-US: Observational memory: {stage} skipped — all candidates failed (sessionFallback disabled, won't use main model)

omStageUnavailableRetry.zh-CN: 观察记忆：{stage} 已跳过；模型不可用（冷却设为 0，{fallbacks}，将在下次运行重试）。
omStageUnavailableRetry.en-US: Observational memory: {stage} skipped — model unavailable (cooldown set to 0, {fallbacks}, will retry next run)

observerRunning.zh-CN: 观察记忆：观察器正在处理约 {chunk} token 的分块（累计 {total} token）。
observerRunning.en-US: Observational memory: observer running on ~{chunk}-token chunk (of {total} accumulated)

observerInputTooLarge.zh-CN: 观察记忆：观察器正在跳过 {model}（上下文窗口 {window} 太小，无法容纳约 {input} token 的输入）。
observerInputTooLarge.en-US: Observational memory: observer skipping {model} (context window {window} too small for ~{input}-token input)

observationsRecorded.zh-CN: 观察记忆：已记录 {count} 条观察。

observerNoToolCall.zh-CN: 模型没有调用观察工具
observerNoToolCall.en-US: model did not call the observation tool

observerInvalidSources.zh-CN: {count} 条观察因 sourceEntryIds 无效而被拒绝

observerDuplicates.zh-CN: {count} 条观察与已记录条目重复
observerDuplicates.en-US: {count} observation(s) were duplicates of already-recorded entries

observerEmptyArray.zh-CN: 模型调用了工具，但提交的 observations 数组为空
observerEmptyArray.en-US: model called the tool but submitted an empty observations array

reflectorRunning.zh-CN: 观察记忆：反思器正在运行（累计约 {total} token，输入约 {input} token）。
reflectorRunning.en-US: Observational memory: reflector running (~{total} tokens accumulated, ~{input}-token input)

reflectorInputTooLarge.zh-CN: 观察记忆：反思器正在跳过 {model}（上下文窗口 {window} 太小，无法容纳约 {input} token 的输入）。
reflectorInputTooLarge.en-US: Observational memory: reflector skipping {model} (context window {window} too small for ~{input}-token input)

dropperRunning.zh-CN: 观察记忆：清理器正在运行（累计约 {total} token，输入约 {input} token）。
dropperRunning.en-US: Observational memory: dropper running (~{total} tokens accumulated, ~{input}-token input)

dropperInputTooLarge.zh-CN: 观察记忆：清理器正在跳过 {model}（上下文窗口 {window} 太小，无法容纳约 {input} token 的输入）。
dropperInputTooLarge.en-US: Observational memory: dropper skipping {model} (context window {window} too small for ~{input}-token input)

autoCompactionThrew.zh-CN: 观察记忆：调用压缩时发生异常：{message}

configInvalidJson.zh-CN: blackhole：配置文件 {path} 包含无效 JSON：{error}。正在使用默认值。
configInvalidJson.en-US: blackhole: config file at {path} has invalid JSON: {error}. Using defaults.

memoryThresholdReserve.zh-CN: · 在 {window} token 窗口中保留 {reserve} token 余量

memoryPassive.zh-CN: 被动：自动记忆 worker 和自动压缩已禁用
memoryPassive.en-US: Passive: automatic memory workers and auto-compaction disabled

memoryObservationsStatus.zh-CN: 观察：{recorded} 已记录 / {dropped} 已丢弃 / {visible} 可见

memoryReflectionsStatus.zh-CN: 反思：{recorded} 已记录 / {visible} 可见

memoryPipelineDescription.en-US: Transcript accumulated since last run. Triggers when exceeding threshold.

memoryObserverProgress.zh-CN: 观察器：      约 {tokens} token（阈值 {threshold}）

memoryReflectorProgress.zh-CN: 反思器：      约 {tokens} token（阈值 {threshold}）

memoryDropperProgress.zh-CN: 清理器：      池 {pool}% — 在 ≥{eligible}% 且有新数据时可运行；{pressure}（{progress}/{threshold} 新 token）
memoryDropperProgress.en-US: Dropper:        pool {pool}% — eligible at ≥{eligible}% with new data; {pressure} ({progress}/{threshold} new tokens)

memoryPendingObservation.zh-CN: 观察：        正在等待写入 pending.json

memoryPendingReflection.zh-CN: 反思：        正在等待写入 pending.json

memoryPendingDropper.zh-CN: 清理器：      正在等待写入 pending.json

memoryPreambleCap.zh-CN: 前导上限：每段 {tokens} token（观察、反思）{note}
memoryPreambleCap.en-US: Preamble cap: {tokens} tokens per section (observations, reflections){note}

memoryRunBlackhole.zh-CN: 运行 /blackhole 写入待处理内容并压缩。

memorySkippedCompactions.zh-CN: 跳过的压缩（上下文已释放）：{count}

thresholdMigrationNotice.zh-CN: pi-blackhole：自动压缩现在可从模型上下文窗口推导阈值（预设曲线，不需要固定阈值）。如果你固定了阈值或关闭了压缩，请重新评估：/blackhole settings → Compaction。详情：/blackhole changelog。
thresholdMigrationNotice.en-US: pi-blackhole: auto-compaction can now derive its threshold from your model's context window (preset curve — no fixed threshold needed). If you pinned a threshold or turned compaction off, reconsider: /blackhole settings → Compaction. Details: /blackhole changelog.

compactOverflowRetry.zh-CN: 溢出压缩已中止，正在重试本轮

fieldCompactionDescription.zh-CN: auto=达到阈值时触发，manual=仅 /blackhole，off=自动：由 Pi 处理，/blackhole：blackhole 流水线
fieldCompactionDescription.en-US: auto=trigger on threshold, manual=only /blackhole, off=auto:Pi handles, /blackhole:blackhole pipeline

fieldCompactionOptionOff.zh-CN: off — 自动：由 Pi 处理，/blackhole：blackhole 流水线

fieldCompactionEngineDescription.zh-CN: blackhole=结构化摘要 + 观察记忆，pi-default=Pi 内置摘要

fieldCompactionEngineOptionBlackhole.zh-CN: blackhole — 结构化摘要 + 观察记忆

fieldCompactionSummaryModeDescription.zh-CN: default=替换一份完整摘要，append=冻结自动分段并在 /blackhole 时重建
fieldCompactionSummaryModeDescription.en-US: default=replace one complete summary, append=freeze automatic segments and rebase on /blackhole

fieldCompactionSummaryModeOptionDefault.zh-CN: default — 一份完整替换摘要

fieldCompactionSummaryModeOptionAppend.zh-CN: append — 自动分段不可变；/blackhole 会重建

fieldTailBehaviorDescription.zh-CN: minimal=只保留最后一条用户消息（默认），pi-default=保留 Pi 已保存的可见上下文
fieldTailBehaviorDescription.en-US: minimal=keep last user message only (default), pi-default=keep Pi's preserved visible context

fieldTailBehaviorOptionMinimal.zh-CN: minimal — 只保留最后一条用户消息（默认）
fieldTailBehaviorOptionMinimal.en-US: minimal — keep last user message only (default)

fieldTailBehaviorOptionPiDefault.zh-CN: pi-default — 保留 Pi 已保存的可见上下文
fieldTailBehaviorOptionPiDefault.en-US: pi-default — keep Pi's preserved visible context

fieldMidRunCompactionDescription.zh-CN: resume=透明压缩并继续同一轮运行，pause=中断并停止，off=仅在运行结束时检查（默认）
fieldMidRunCompactionDescription.en-US: resume=compact transparently and continue the same run, pause=interrupt and stop, off=only check when run ends (default)

fieldMidRunCompactionOptionResume.zh-CN: resume — 透明压缩，同一轮运行（实验性）

fieldMidRunCompactionOptionOff.zh-CN: off — 仅在运行结束时检查（默认）
fieldMidRunCompactionOptionOff.en-US: off — only check when run ends (default)

fieldShowPreCompactionMessageDescription.zh-CN: 仅用于显示的副本（最多 16 KiB），内容是压缩丢弃的最新助手输出。不会进入模型上下文或记忆。
fieldShowPreCompactionMessageDescription.en-US: Display-only copy (max 16 KiB) of the newest assistant output the compaction dropped. Never enters model context or memory.

fieldShowPreCompactionMessageOn.zh-CN: 显示 — 最近输出会重新渲染在压缩卡片下方
fieldShowPreCompactionMessageOn.en-US: Shown — recent output re-rendered below the compaction card

fieldShowPreCompactionMessageOff.zh-CN: 隐藏 — 只显示压缩卡片

fieldCompactAfterTokensDescription.zh-CN: 显式固定 token 阈值；优先于窗口推导旋钮和预设曲线。0 = 未设置（由预设曲线、比例或预留量决定）。
fieldCompactAfterTokensDescription.en-US: Explicit fixed token threshold; wins over the window-derived knobs and the preset curve. 0 = not set (a preset curve, ratio, or reserve governs).

fieldRetainedToolOutputMaxTokensDescript.zh-CN: 历史工具输出文本的 token 预算；优先保留最新内容，更早的文本仍可通过 recall 获取
fieldRetainedToolOutputMaxTokensDescript.en-US: Token budget for historical tool-output text; newest is retained first and older text remains available via recall

fieldCompactAfterRatioLabel.zh-CN: 自动压缩比例（相对上下文窗口）

fieldCompactAfterRatioDescription.zh-CN: 当会话达到当前模型上下文窗口的该比例时压缩（例如 0.65，在 200k 模型上约 130k 触发）。0 = 未设置。显式 token 阈值优先；也优先于预留量旋钮和预设曲线。
fieldCompactAfterRatioDescription.en-US: Compact when the session reaches this fraction of the active model's context window (e.g. 0.65 on a 200k model fires at ~130k). 0 = not set. An explicit token threshold wins; beats the reserve knob and the preset curve.

fieldCompactReserveTokensDescription.zh-CN: 另一种窗口推导旋钮：当剩余余量只剩这么多 token 时压缩（阈值 = 窗口 − 预留量）。0 = 未设置。显式 token 阈值优先；两者都设置时比例优先。
fieldCompactReserveTokensDescription.en-US: Alternative window-derived knob: compact when only this many tokens of headroom remain (threshold = window − reserve). 0 = not set. An explicit token threshold wins; ratio wins when both are set.

fieldCompactAfterPresetDescription.zh-CN: 当上面的数值旋钮都未设置时，用按窗口缩放的曲线设置阈值（默认：32k 窗口压缩到 90%，到 1M 时降到 40%）。要编辑曲线或添加预设，请直接修改配置文件中的 compactAfterPresets。
fieldCompactAfterPresetDescription.en-US: Window-scaled curve that sets the threshold when no numeric knob above is set (default: compact at 90% of a 32k window, falling to 40% at 1M). To edit the curve or add presets, hand-edit compactAfterPresets in the config file.

fieldMemoryDescription.zh-CN: 启用观察记忆工作进程（观察器、反思器、清理器）和内容注入
fieldMemoryDescription.en-US: Enable OM workers (observer, reflector, dropper) and content injection

fieldMemoryOn.zh-CN: 启用 — 观察记忆工作进程 + 内容注入已开启
fieldMemoryOn.en-US: Active — OM workers + content injection enabled

fieldMemoryOff.zh-CN: 暂停 — 观察记忆已关闭

fieldSessionFallbackDescription.zh-CN: off=所有观察记忆模型失败时跳过该阶段，而不是回退到主编码模型
fieldSessionFallbackDescription.en-US: off=skip stage when all OM models fail, instead of falling back to the main coding model

fieldObserveAfterTokensDescription.zh-CN: 自上次观察器运行后累计的 token 数，达到后触发下一次观察
fieldObserveAfterTokensDescription.en-US: Tokens accumulated since last observer run before triggering next observe

fieldReflectAfterTokensDescription.zh-CN: 自上次反思后累计的 token 数，达到后触发反思器和清理器
fieldReflectAfterTokensDescription.en-US: Tokens accumulated since last reflect before triggering reflector and dropper

fieldObservationsPoolMaxTokensDescriptio.zh-CN: 完整折叠压力，以及压缩输出中观察行的最大估算 token 数
fieldObservationsPoolMaxTokensDescriptio.en-US: Full-fold pressure and max estimated rendered observation-line tokens in compaction output

fieldReflectionsPoolMaxTokensDescription.zh-CN: 压缩输出中反思行的最大估算 token 数。0 表示关闭上限。完整源记录仍可通过 recall 获取。
fieldReflectionsPoolMaxTokensDescription.en-US: Max estimated rendered reflection-line tokens in compaction output. 0 disables the cap. Full source records remain available through recall.

fieldObservationsPoolTargetTokensDescrip.zh-CN: 清理器裁剪后的目标 token 数（默认是池上限的一半）
fieldObservationsPoolTargetTokensDescrip.en-US: Target tokens after dropper prunes (defaults to half of pool max)

fieldReflectorInputMaxTokensDescription.zh-CN: 反思器模型输入的最大 prompt token 数（滚动窗口上限）
fieldReflectorInputMaxTokensDescription.en-US: Max prompt tokens for reflector model input (rolling window cap)

fieldDropperInputMaxTokensDescription.zh-CN: 清理器模型输入的最大 prompt token 数（滚动窗口上限）
fieldDropperInputMaxTokensDescription.en-US: Max prompt tokens for dropper model input (rolling window cap)

fieldObserverChunkMaxTokensDescription.zh-CN: 每个分块发送给观察器的最大源条目 token 数
fieldObserverChunkMaxTokensDescription.en-US: Max source entry tokens sent to observer per chunk

fieldObserverPreambleMaxTokensDescriptio.zh-CN: 手动压缩模式下的前导预算（0=自动按分块的 30% 计算）
fieldObserverPreambleMaxTokensDescriptio.en-US: Preamble budget in manual compaction mode (0=auto-compute 30% of chunk)

fieldDropperPressureThresholdDescription.zh-CN: 触发压力驱动清理器的 observationsPoolMaxTokens 比例（1 表示关闭）
fieldDropperPressureThresholdDescription.en-US: Fraction of observationsPoolMaxTokens that triggers pressure-driven dropper (1 disables)

fieldDropperPoolFullnessThresholdDescrip.zh-CN: 清理器运行前观察池的最小满度（相对池上限的比例，0-1，默认 0.10）
fieldDropperPoolFullnessThresholdDescrip.en-US: Min observation-pool fullness (fraction of pool max) before the dropper runs (0-1, default 0.10)

fieldAgentMaxTurnsLabel.zh-CN: 每个智能体的最大轮次

fieldAgentMaxTurnsDescription.zh-CN: 后台记忆智能体共用的轮次上限
fieldAgentMaxTurnsDescription.en-US: Shared turn cap for background memory agents

fieldProviderIdleTimeoutMsDescription.zh-CN: 后台提供方流的正文空闲超时；0 = 关闭，未设置 = 继承 Pi 的默认值
fieldProviderIdleTimeoutMsDescription.en-US: Body-idle timeout for background provider streams; 0 = disabled, unset = inherit pi's default

fieldCacheRetentionLabel.zh-CN: 工作进程 prompt 缓存保留

fieldCacheRetentionDescription.zh-CN: 记忆工作进程的提供方无关 prompt 缓存保留；未设置时跟随 Pi 的有效设置。适配器会忽略它们不支持的值。
fieldCacheRetentionDescription.en-US: Provider-neutral prompt-cache retention for the memory workers; unset defers to pi's effective setting. Adapters ignore values they do not support.

fieldCacheRetentionOptionUnset.zh-CN: unset — 继承 Pi 的有效设置

fieldCacheRetentionOptionNone.zh-CN: none — 在支持的地方不使用 prompt 缓存
fieldCacheRetentionOptionNone.en-US: none — no prompt caching where supported

fieldCacheRetentionOptionShort.zh-CN: short — Pi 的提供方默认值

fieldCacheRetentionOptionLong.zh-CN: long — 在支持的地方延长保留

fieldWorkerAttemptTimeoutMsLabel.zh-CN: 工作进程尝试超时（毫秒）

fieldWorkerAttemptTimeoutMsDescription.zh-CN: 每次工作进程/模型尝试的硬性耗时上限；超时会中止调用并尝试下一个回退；0 = 关闭
fieldWorkerAttemptTimeoutMsDescription.en-US: Hard elapsed deadline per worker/model attempt; timeout aborts the call and tries the next fallback; 0 = disabled

fieldFullFoldAlwaysLabel.zh-CN: 首次压缩时保留观察记忆

fieldFullFoldAlwaysDescription.zh-CN: 为 true 时，新会话第一次压缩仍会保留早期反思和清理结果
fieldFullFoldAlwaysDescription.en-US: When true, early reflections/drops survive the first compaction in a fresh session

fieldStatusBarDescription.zh-CN: 在页脚显示 token 量表（O/P/X）和工作进程事件
fieldStatusBarDescription.en-US: Show token gauges (O/P/X) and worker events in the footer

fieldShowWorkerNotificationsDescription.zh-CN: 显示常规观察器/反思器/清理器进度提示；警告、错误和压缩通知始终显示
fieldShowWorkerNotificationsDescription.en-US: Show routine observer/reflector/dropper progress toasts; warnings, errors and compaction notices always show

fieldShowWorkerNotificationsOn.zh-CN: 开 — 显示常规工作进程进度提示
fieldShowWorkerNotificationsOn.en-US: On — routine worker progress toasts shown

fieldShowWorkerNotificationsOff.zh-CN: 关 — 安静模式；只显示警告/错误

fieldDebugLogDescription.zh-CN: 把结构化 JSONL 调试日志写入智能体目录
fieldDebugLogDescription.en-US: Write structured JSONL debug logs to agent directory

scopeNotePending.zh-CN: 在会话文件存在前保存在内存中 — 之后会自动持久化
scopeNotePending.en-US: in-memory until session file exists — will persist automatically

scopeNoteSessionOverrides.zh-CN: 每个叶子节点的内存覆盖（作为 {entryType} 持久化到会话 JSONL）
scopeNoteSessionOverrides.en-US: in-memory per-leaf overrides (persisted to session JSONL as {entryType})
